name: TZFlng
description: Through-zero stereo vocal & tape flanger with external SDRAM delay lines and all-pass feedback dispersion.

params.name: ManMs
params.explanation: Base delay / static comb tuning (0.5..8.0 ms; 2.5 ms is through-zero center).

params.name: Env
params.explanation: Vocal envelope modulation depth and direction (-100..+100%).

params.name: Drift
params.explanation: Non-periodic micro-drift modulation depth (0..100%; 0 for frozen static comb).

params.name: Fdbk
params.explanation: Bipolar all-pass dispersed feedback (-65..+65%; neg = hollow industrial, pos = metallic bite).

params.name: Depth
params.explanation: Bipolar wet blend (-100..+100%; neg = through-zero phase cancel, pos = additive flange).

params.name: Wide
params.explanation: Stereo mode (MONO = dual T_mod, WIDE = Eventide T_mod Left / inverted 0.5*T_mod Right).
